punchline: In the large organizations Gallup surveyed, only 20 percent of employees strongly agreed they get to do what they do best every day.
thirty_sec: Gallup asked 198,000 employees one question: do you have the opportunity to do what you do best every day? Those who strongly agreed were more likely to work in units with lower turnover, higher productivity and higher customer satisfaction, though that is an association. Across a database of 1.7 million employees, only 20 percent of those in large organizations strongly agreed.
